blurb_title: The Secret says admin456. The application accepts admin123. Both are right.
blurb_1: This guide brings static secrets from OpenBao into the cluster with the External Secrets Operator – field by field, as a whole secret, by pattern, as a rendered file – and writes them back with PushSecret. Every variant tested on the cluster, with the policy line it needs.
blurb_2: And four errors that lie in wait for every rotation: the policy that does not know the path; kv put deleting a field; the pod that never reads the new Secret; the application that only takes the password on its first start. Reloader solves one of them.
